name: 小米 MiMo 开放平台

freeTierSummary.zh-CN: 用邀请链接注册小米 MiMo 开放平台，双方各得 ¥10 API 体验金（自到账起 40 天内有效），首单充值再享 9 折。控制台创建 API Key 后即可通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用 mimo-v2.6-pro（1M 上下文、全模态）/ mimo-v2.6-flash / pro-ultraspeed，定价页当前把 mimo-v2.5-tts 语音合成标为免费。赠送金额与活动期限以控制台为准。
freeTierSummary.en: Register on the Xiaomi MiMo open platform through the invitation link and both sides get ¥10 in API credit (valid 40 days), plus 10% off the first top-up. Create an API key to call mimo-v2.6-pro (1M context, full-modal), mimo-v2.6-flash and pro-ultraspeed over the OpenAI-compatible endpoint; pricing currently lists mimo-v2.5-tts as free. Check the console for promo terms.
